answer: Prayers & Duties >> Zakat & Charity Question ID: 156802 Country: India Title: Zakah for the basic need of a child Question: How to give some one zakah for basic school & college education to a Muslim? What is the right way to proceed or process? The intention is to make the person self reliant or self sustainable. Answer ID: 156802 Posted on: Sep 1, 2020 Bismillah hir-Rahman nir-Rahim ! (Fatwa: 316/275/L=3/1439) If the child is poor and adult or minor but sane and his father is poor and eligible to receive zakah then it is allowable to give him zakah money. The method of giving zakah amount is that either the zakah amount is given to the child into his complete possession or some material related to school is bought with zakah money and given to the child. Thus zakah shall be paid. Allah (Subhana Wa Ta'ala) knows Best Darul Ifta, Darul Uloom Deoband, India
